name: Cute Links – Free Link Branding and Link Cloaker Plugin with Click Tracking
author: Sadhan Pal

sections.description:
Top WordPress Link Cloaker plugin to make the links beautiful. Increase your affiliate revenue using this plugin.

Plugin Documentation: https://wordpress.org/plugins/cute-links

Live Demo

Key Features

  • Cloak links.
  • Easy to use.
  • One-click copy Cute Links.
  • Manage links.
  • Search links on dashboard.
  • Edit existing links.
  • Delete facility.

[UPDATE] We promise updates at the right time

Cute Links is a affiliate link shortner plugin that lets you short the ugly looking affiliate links.

Video Tutorial

How To Use

After you have installed the plugin, you will see a Cute Links item in your admin dashboard menu.
Click on it. Then there you will get all the advantages of this plugin.

  1. You can cloak links.
  2. You can copy cute links by one click.
  3. You can edit and delete existing links.

You’re done!
sections.installation:
This is the way you can install and use the plugin:

  1. Install Cute Links either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate Cute Links.
  3. Go to ‘Cute Links’ from the dashboard and cloak your links.
sections.faq:
Who should use Cute Links?

Anybody who run wordpress website and want to make affiliate links simple.

Do I need to have coding skills to use Cute Links?

Absolutely not.

Links are not working properly. What should I do?

Clear your cache and try again.
